verdict.rationale: Ramp's docs say it can issue cards and attach controls: physical cards for in-person employee spend and virtual cards for reusable payment details (ramp-docs-7). Custom virtual cards can be scoped per team (ramp-docs-11) and issued instantly with per-vendor spending limits (ramp-docs-31). Funds carry amount and interval limits, and limits are enforced before spend happens (ramp-docs-41, ramp-docs-9). Missing for 10: evidence that physical cards can be issued and delivered 'in minutes' (speed is only claimed for virtual cards), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the issuance flow.
